shared_elements: schematic non-figurative or hard-to-read motif on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry a single dominant elongated schematic motif with projections, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be: A shows one solid, fully infilled amorphous shape, while B shows several superimposed linear outline vessels with hull lines, internal grids and rows of short vertical crew strokes. The manner of depiction is opposite (massed silhouette versus thin contour drawing with repeated internal detail), and B's multi-figure, overlapping composition has no counterpart in A.
